simple.meaning: סָלָא (çâlâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to suspend in a balance, i.e. weigh.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Lamentations, beginning at Lamentations 4:2. The surrounding contexts include family line.

definitions.short: to suspend in a balance, i.e. weigh
definitions.full: H5537. sala [ סָלָא ] verb weigh (Arabic pay promptly Lane 1398 ; compare Sabean סלא consecrate, devote Hom ZMG xivi (1892), 531; Süd-Arab. Chrest. 124 ); — only Pu`al Participle בַּמָּ֑ז הַמְסֻלָּאִים Lam 4:2 they who were weighed against gold , reckoned of such value. — compare also II. סלה .
